explanation: Nintendo began in Kyoto in 1889, making hanafuda playing cards. It moved into video games in the 1970s, about 40 years after Uruguay hosted the first World Cup.

claims.text: Nintendo was founded in Kyoto in September 1889 as a maker of hanafuda playing cards.
The first FIFA World Cup was played in Uruguay in July 1930.
Nintendo began making video game products in the 1970s.
Uruguay hosted the first FIFA World Cup.
